caption: The drawing depicts a cup shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. The cup is predominantly a pale, off-white color with a slight grey tone. The exterior is decorated with painted floral designs consisting of blue and white flowers with green leaves and red-tipped stamens. The side view shows the floral pattern wrapping partially around the body of the cup, while the base of the cup is plain. The top view shows the interior of the cup with a similar floral design, featuring one prominent blue flower and a smaller white flower with green leaves and stems at the center. Both perspectives of the cup are enclosed within a single rectangular border, and the word "Cup" is written in the lower left corner, while the artist's name and date "J. Gowan dline. 1735." appears in the lower right corner. The background is a plain, light beige.
title: Tea Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
